user.description: Search for your address (VafabMiljö's pickup calendar works without logging in).

address.description: Choose your address from the matches. Invoices, fees and the property come later: log in to Mina sidor with BankID in the VafabMiljö panel (Settings → Account).

reauth_confirm.description: Your login to VafabMiljö Mina sidor has run out (it lasts 7 days). Open the **VafabMiljö** panel in the sidebar, go to **Settings → Account** and click **Log in again** - the QR code and the BankID link there stay up to date. Submit to close this dialog.

reconfigure.description: Search for the new address to bind this entry to.

reconfigure_address.description: Choose the new address from the matches.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach VafabMiljö. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This address is already set up in Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_use_panel: Log in again from the VafabMiljö panel (Settings → Account).

init.description: This is a waste-collection calendar, not live data - the default 30 minutes is usually plenty.

download_invoice.name: Download invoice
download_invoice.description: Fetches one invoice as a PDF and saves it to HA's local www folder.

invoice_id.name: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: The invoice's id, from the Latest invoice sensor's 'invoices' attribute.

bankid_expired.title: VafabMiljö: log in to Mina sidor again
bankid_expired.description: The login to VafabMiljö Mina sidor for **{address}** has run out or isn't done yet, so invoices, fees and the property aren't updated (pickup dates still are). Open the VafabMiljö panel (Learn more), go to **Settings → Account** and click **Log in again**.

login_expiring.title: VafabMiljö: the login runs out soon
login_expiring.description: The login to VafabMiljö Mina sidor for **{address}** runs out on **{expires}** (it lasts 7 days and can't be extended). Log in again with BankID before then from the VafabMiljö panel (Learn more) → **Settings → Account** → **Log in again**, so invoices keep updating. The event `vafabmiljo_login_expiring` is fired as well, for a reminder on your phone.
